description: Implementation of a multi-producer, single-consumer (MPSC) ring buffer with functions for initialization, allocation, commit, free, and utilization tracking, including debug and drop mechanisms.

methods.name: mpsc_state_print
methods.description: Prints the current state of the buffer indices for debugging.

methods.name: free_space
methods.description: Calculates available free space in the buffer, considering wrap-around.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Calculates the amount of valid data available in the buffer.

methods.name: get_usage
methods.description: Returns the current buffer usage in terms of data length.

methods.name: max_utilization_update
methods.description: Updates the maximum buffer utilization metric if enabled.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if a buffer item is valid.

methods.name: is_invalid
methods.description: Checks if a buffer item is invalid.

methods.name: idx_inc
methods.description: Increments buffer index with wrap-around based on buffer size.

methods.name: get_skip
methods.description: Returns the skip length if the item is a skip packet.

methods.name: tmp_wr_idx_inc
methods.description: Increments temporary write index and sets full flag if needed.

methods.name: rd_idx_inc
methods.description: Increments read index and clears full flag.

methods.name: add_skip_item
methods.description: Adds a skip packet to the buffer to free space.

methods.name: drop_item_locked
methods.description: Drops an item from the buffer, handling busy and invalid items, with overwrite mode support.

methods.name: post_drop_action
methods.description: Handles post-drop buffer index adjustments and skip marking.

methods.name: mpsc_pbuf_put_word
methods.description: Adds a word to the buffer, handling drop if full.

methods.name: mpsc_pbuf_alloc
methods.description: Allocates space in the buffer for a new item, with timeout and drop support.

methods.name: mpsc_pbuf_commit
methods.description: Marks an allocated item as valid and updates buffer indices.

methods.name: mpsc_pbuf_put_word_ext
methods.description: Adds an item with extended data to the buffer.

methods.name: mpsc_pbuf_put_data
methods.description: Copies data into the buffer as a new item.

methods.name: mpsc_pbuf_claim
methods.description: Claims an item for reading from the buffer.

methods.name: mpsc_pbuf_free
methods.description: Frees a claimed item, marking it invalid and updating indices.
